subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should OpenClaw add a core pinned-facts UI/storage contract now, fold this into the broader memory panel, or wait for Control UI plugin contribution slots?
rationale: The code path is feasible, but the permanent contract affects trusted context, persistent user state, and whether this is a first-party Control UI feature or a plugin/API extension.

options.title: Spec With Memory Panel
options.body: Define pinned facts as part of the memory panel work, including storage, diff preview, freshness labels, and context injection behavior before implementation.

options.title: Core Panel Now
options.body: Build a first-party pinned-facts panel directly in the Control UI after explicit security acceptance of the new write surface.

options.title: Plugin Slot First
options.body: Wait for Control UI contribution slots and let a memory/context plugin own this panel, trading faster UX for a cleaner extension boundary.

recommendation.title: Spec With Memory Panel
recommendation.body: Define pinned facts as part of the memory panel work, including storage, diff preview, freshness labels, and context injection behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available routing owner from current UI/context blame and the recent agents-panel split history.
